1.title: Texas Book List: See What Students Will Be Required to Read
1.summary: What is essential reading? Texas has an answer: Classics, including the Bible.

2.title: Pentagon Identifies 2 U.S. Soldiers Killed in Jordan
2.summary: Both were active-duty soldiers, the Defense Department said. They were killed in action after an Iranian strike on a U.S. base on Friday.

3.title: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding
3.summary: A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.

4.title: Another U.S. Service Member Is Killed as Iran War Expands
4.summary: The Pentagon said a service member was killed in northern Iraq while troops disposed of an Iranian drone. It also said “unidentified remains” were found in Jordan, where an earlier attack had left two soldiers dead and another missing.

5.title: Newcastle, Liverpool and England legend Keegan dies
5.summary: Former England captain and manager Kevin Keegan dies at the age of 75, seven weeks after he revealed he had been diagnosed with stage four cancer.

6.title: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
6.summary: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.
